text_block_list.text:
It happened when I went out with Rhein 
Kraft. She suddenly stopped in front of a 
standing sign.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"'Authentic Leathercraft Workshop♪ Work 
with real leather to make your very own 
original keychain'... maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa—! Leathercraft, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you so much! I wonder what kind 
of keychain I should make~

text_block_list.name: Lecturer
text_block_list.text:
What kind of shape would you all like to 
make~? First, let's decide on the design 
for the keychain.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... Maybe a star shape would be 
nice. With a more mature color palette—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What's the matter? You froze up 
completely.

I try to come up with a design for the 
keychain, but... nothing really clicks. 
It's like I can't find a starting point 
for the design.
choice_data_list: I couldn't think of what to make...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see, I see... In that case, how 
about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll try making it with the intention of 
giving it to someone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, there was a time recently when 
I gave Messiah-san a glasses case as a 
present—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should match my glasses and go 
with orange, or... what kind of embroidery 
should I put on the fabric, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
When I make things thinking about how I 
want to bring joy to others, the designs 
just naturally come to me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, why don't you try making one 
while thinking of the person you want to 
give it to?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's just how it is for me! I'm 
not sure if it'll be helpful for you, 
but...
choice_data_list: ...No, thanks! I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.text:
Picture the person you want to give it to. 
If it's for them, then this keychain 
should be— Suddenly, design ideas came 
flooding in!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The shape looks good to go. All right. How 
about yours, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! Those are bird feathers, 
right? They're super cute!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Trainer's advice.
It's all thanks to Trainer's advice, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Teacher"...? You mean... me?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're exaggerating~.

"Still, the truth is, thanks to her 
advice, I feel like I can make it turn out 
great. Just changing my mindset made this 
much of a difference—..."
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, is there someone you 
want to give one to?

Come to think of it, is there someone you 
want to give one to?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes there is, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I made it star-shaped, hoping it would 
leave a lasting impression in their 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The sights we saw together, and the 
closeness we built side-by-side."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Every time you look at this star shape, I 
hope... you'll remember me—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
P-Please forget what just happened! U-Uhm, 
next is cutting the leather with the 
utility knife...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's almost ready, Trainer! All that's 
left is attaching the keyring—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! It's so wonderful! I can't wait 
to show this off to everyone.
choice_data_list: If it's okay, will you take this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? This is... for me...?
choice_data_list: I made this thinking of giving it to you.
I made this thinking I'd give it to you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Well, here is one from me too!
What Rhein Kraft handed to me was—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to preserve today's 
memories. If you feel the same way, 
Trainer, that makes me happy..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I'll cherish the keychain!
choice_data_list: I want to make it with Craft again.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I'll cherish the keychain!
choice_data_list: I want to make it with Craft again.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Treasure, huh? Ehehe, that sounds really 
nice!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Leather accessories take on more and more 
of their owner's character the more you 
use them."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"So, that treasure... please hold onto it 
forever, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Next time, I'd love to 
try a collaborative project."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Worrying together over what to make, 
laughing together when it ended in 
failure... and then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking... how nice it would 
be if we could make some memories 
together, Trainer.
